description: Two required protein subunits of the class 1B holoenzyme.

description: Single-protein catalytic system including bifunctional UMP synthase.

description: Single-protein catalytic system including bifunctional aspartokinase architectures.

description: Single-protein catalytic system; MetA and MetX orthologues are both accepted because KEGG assigns both acyl chemistries to both.

name: homoserine O-acetyltransferase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; MetA and MetX orthologues are both accepted because KEGG assigns both acyl chemistries to both.

description: Single-protein catalytic system acting on O-succinyl-L-homoserine.

description: Single-protein catalytic system acting on O-acetyl-L-homoserine.

name: plant cystathionine gamma-synthase
description: Single-protein catalytic system acting on O-phospho-L-homoserine.

description: Single-protein catalytic system restricted to the dedicated sulfhydrylase orthologue.

description: Single-protein catalytic system with alternative orthology markers.

description: Single-protein catalytic system; the cobalamin cofactor is not a separate evidence component.

description: Single-protein catalytic system with alternative orthology markers.

description: Single-protein catalytic system acting on L-serine.

description: Single-protein catalytic system acting on O-acetyl-L-serine.

description: Single-protein catalytic system with alternative orthology markers.

description: Three jointly required subunits; characterised on both pentoses.

description: Single-protein catalytic system; CAZy families and orthologues are alternative evidence for the same role.

description: Single-protein catalytic system; CAZy families and orthologues are alternative evidence for the same role.

name: acetylxylan esterase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; CAZy families and orthologues are alternative evidence for the same role.

name: microbial collagenase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; the orthologue and the Pfam domain are alternative evidence for the same protein, not alternative enzymes.

name: alpha/beta-E1 pyruvate dehydrogenase complex
description: Four jointly required components; the E1 decarboxylase is a separate alpha and beta subunit pair.

name: fused-E1 pyruvate dehydrogenase complex
description: Three jointly required components; the E1 decarboxylase is a single polypeptide, as in Escherichia coli AceE.

name: four-subunit pyruvate:ferredoxin oxidoreductase
description: Four jointly required subunits of the archaeal and clostridial PorABCD architecture.

name: fused pyruvate:ferredoxin/flavodoxin oxidoreductase
description: Single fused polypeptide carrying all four domains.

name: pyruvate formate-lyase with its activating enzyme
description: Two jointly required proteins: the lyase is inactive until the activating enzyme installs its glycyl radical.

name: phosphate acetyltransferase
description: Single-protein catalytic system with alternative orthology markers.

name: butanoyl-CoA dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein system. The electron-transfer flavoprotein partner is not a required component: K03521 and K03522 are the generic fixA and fixB orthologues shared with nitrogen fixation, present in 7729 KEGG organisms, so requiring them would cost recall without adding specificity.

name: butyryl-CoA:acetate CoA-transferase
description: Single catalytic protein system evidenced by a substrate-specific sequence family rather than an orthology group.

name: coenzyme-B12-dependent propanediol dehydratase
description: Three jointly required subunits of the PduCDE holoenzyme.

name: propionate kinase
description: Single-protein catalytic system with alternative orthology markers.

name: lactoyl-CoA dehydratase
description: Two jointly required subunits. The LcdC activator has no orthology group and is not required evidence.

name: NAD-dependent L-lactate dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein system. Only the NAD-dependent enzyme is accepted; the quinone- and cytochrome-dependent L-lactate dehydrogenases are separate orthology groups and evidence the consuming direction, which is what makes this trait's direction evidenced rather than asserted.

name: lactate racemase
description: Single catalytic protein system. The LarBCE maturation proteins that install the nickel-pincer cofactor are not required evidence: they are a maturation pathway rather than part of the racemase, and requiring them would make the trait a cofactor claim.

name: citrate lyase holoenzyme
description: Three subunits and the ligase that activates them. Apo-citrate lyase carries an unacetylated acyl-carrier subunit and is inactive, so the ligase is required rather than accessory; 912 of the 960 genomes with the three subunits carry it, so requiring it costs almost nothing.

name: sodium-extruding oxaloacetate decarboxylase
description: Membrane-bound decarboxylase of the Enterobacteriaceae and the lactic acid bacteria. Only the alpha subunit is required: KEGG assigns the beta subunit group K01572 in a single organism, so requiring it would refuse the trait everywhere.

name: soluble oxaloacetate decarboxylase
description: Alternative single-protein system, accepted as an OR alternative to the sodium-extruding complex.

name: bifunctional acetaldehyde dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein system. The same protein carries the alcohol dehydrogenase activity of the next step, so the route rests on one marker across two reactions.

name: bifunctional alcohol dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein system, the second activity of the same protein.

name: acetolactate synthase
description: Single catalytic protein system for a step the route does not require. Its orthology group is the anabolic branched-chain amino acid synthase, so it is curated for the chemistry and excluded from the evidence.

name: acetolactate decarboxylase
description: Single catalytic protein system, and the step the trait rests on. The enzyme exists only for this pathway.

name: pyridoxal 5-phosphate synthase complex
description: Two jointly required subunits: the synthase and its glutaminase partner.

name: cobaltochelatase CobNST
description: Three jointly required subunits; late cobalt insertion is what distinguishes the aerobic route.

name: si-citrate synthase
description: Single catalytic protein, EC 2.3.3.1, the canonical gltA group.

name: Re-citrate synthase
description: Single catalytic protein, EC 2.3.3.3. Same reaction, unrelated protein: a non-homologous replacement.

name: citrate synthase of the 2-methylcitrate synthase orthology group
description: The group KEGG names prpC. It is accepted because it carries genuine citrate synthases, including Staphylococcus aureus citZ and Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron BT_2070, and because KEGG lists it as a citrate synthase alternative in modules M00009 and M00010. It also carries true 2-methylcitrate synthases, so the evidence is recorded as ambiguous.

name: aconitate hydratase
description: Single catalytic protein with three alternative orthology groups. K01682 and K27802 are bifunctional with 2-methylisocitrate dehydratase and still catalyse this reaction.

name: 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase multienzyme complex
description: Three jointly required components. The E3 dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase is shared with pyruvate dehydrogenase, which is why it is required together with the 2-oxoglutarate-specific E1 and E2 rather than alone.

name: 2-oxoglutarate:ferredoxin oxidoreductase
description: Two jointly required catalytic subunits. Four-subunit forms exist and their gamma and delta subunits are not required, because requiring them would call the two-subunit enzymes negative.

name: succinyl-CoA synthetase, LSC type
description: Two jointly required subunits. KEGG records both the ADP- and the GDP-forming EC numbers for this group, which is why the two nucleotide specificities are not curated as separate reactions.

name: NAD-dependent succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein with alternative orthology groups.

name: NADP-dependent succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein with alternative orthology groups.

name: succinate dehydrogenase and fumarate reductase, shared orthology group
description: Two jointly required catalytic subunits. KEGG names these groups sdhA, frdA and sdhB, frdB because outside the Enterobacteriaceae the two enzymes are not separated. The membrane anchor subunits are not required: they are poorly conserved and requiring them would call 402 further genomes negative.

name: succinate dehydrogenase, mitochondrial type
description: Two jointly required catalytic subunits of the eukaryotic and alphaproteobacterial-type complex.

name: fumarate reductase, dedicated group
description: Two jointly required catalytic subunits. This group exists as a separate orthology group almost only in the Enterobacteriaceae, where it is a paralogue of the succinate dehydrogenase the same genomes also carry.

name: fumarate hydratase class I, single chain
fumarate hydratase class I, two subunits
description: Two jointly required subunits of the split class I enzyme.

name: NAD-dependent malate dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein with alternative orthology groups for the bacterial and the eukaryotic enzymes.

name: class I DAHP synthase
description: Single catalytic protein system. The AroF/AroG/AroH family of allosterically regulated enzymes.

name: class II DAHP synthase
description: Single catalytic protein system. A structurally unrelated family found in Mycobacterium, Streptomyces and many archaea; a non-homologous replacement for class I rather than a variant of it.

name: bifunctional DAHP synthase/chorismate mutase
description: Single catalytic protein system carrying both the first step of the pathway and the first step of the phenylalanine and tyrosine branch.

name: bifunctional AroKB
description: Single catalytic protein system carrying both the dehydroquinate synthase and the shikimate kinase activity.

name: type I 3-dehydroquinate dehydratase
description: Single catalytic protein system. A Schiff-base enzyme, mechanistically and structurally unrelated to type II.

name: type II 3-dehydroquinate dehydratase
description: Single catalytic protein system. A dodecameric enzyme with an anti elimination mechanism; a non-homologous replacement for type I.

name: bifunctional AroDE
description: Single catalytic protein system carrying both the dehydratase and the shikimate dehydrogenase activity.

name: bifunctional AroDE
description: Single catalytic protein system carrying both the dehydroquinate dehydratase and the shikimate dehydrogenase activity.

name: quinate/shikimate dehydrogenase YdiB
description: Single catalytic protein system. An AroE paralogue that accepts both quinate and shikimate, and that Rhea records against this master reaction alongside AroE.

name: bifunctional AroKB
description: Single catalytic protein system carrying both the shikimate kinase and the dehydroquinate synthase activity.

name: bifunctional prephenate dehydrogenase/EPSP synthase
description: Single catalytic protein system carrying the carboxyvinyl transfer fused to a branch-pathway dehydrogenase.

name: salicylate synthase MbtI
description: Single catalytic protein system. Bifunctional: it isomerises chorismate and eliminates pyruvate in one active site, and releases free isochorismate slowly enough to have been characterised as an isochorismate synthase in its own right.

name: salicylate synthase MbtI
description: Single catalytic protein system carrying the second half of the salicylate synthase reaction.

name: amidase signature family hydrolase
description: Single catalytic protein system. The broad amidase group, accepted here only because the preceding monooxygenase carries the pathway claim.

name: HpxO urate hydroxylase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; a flavin-dependent alternative to the cofactor-independent urate oxidase.

name: 5-hydroxyisourate hydrolase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; the transthyretin-like protein.

name: OHCU decarboxylase
description: Single-protein catalytic system. The step also proceeds spontaneously to racemic allantoin, which is why the routes curate it with required = 0.

name: urease catalytic core
description: Three jointly required subunits. The nickel maturation proteins UreD, UreE, UreF and UreG are deliberately excluded: they perform metallocentre assembly rather than catalysis, and requiring all four costs 984 genomes.

name: NasA/NasC assimilatory nitrate reductase
description: Single catalytic subunit. The NasB diaphorase subunit is not required: it is annotated in 439 bacteria against 2796 for the catalytic subunit.

name: NasDE nitrite reductase
description: Two jointly required subunits of the nitrate-assimilation operon.

name: GbcAB glycine betaine monooxygenase
description: Two jointly required subunits: the Rieske oxygenase and its reductase.

name: DgcAB dimethylglycine dehydrogenase
description: Two jointly required subunits. The same protein pair also carries the sarcosine reaction RHEA:74155, so it is a multifunctional system represented at both reactions.

name: DgcAB sarcosine dehydrogenase
description: Two jointly required subunits; the same multifunctional pair that carries RHEA:74167.

name: CntAB carnitine monooxygenase
description: Two jointly required subunits: the Rieske oxygenase and its reductase.

name: carnitine 3-dehydrogenase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; K27497 is a bifunctional protein that also carries the thioesterase step.

name: CdhC 3-dehydrocarnitine transferase
description: Single-protein catalytic system. Despite the enzyme name, the product is the betainyl thioester and no free trimethylamine is released.

name: betainyl-CoA thioesterase
description: Single-protein catalytic system. Its only orthology group is bifunctional with carnitine 3-dehydrogenase, so the step is curated with required = 0.

name: MauAB methylamine dehydrogenase
description: Two jointly required subunits of the tryptophan-tryptophylquinone enzyme.

name: benzoate 1,2-dioxygenase oxygenase component
description: Two-subunit oxygenase. The shared ferredoxin and ferredoxin reductase components of this system are deliberately not curated: they are interchangeable between Rieske systems and are annotated two to three times less often than the substrate-determining subunits, so requiring them would turn an annotation gap into a missing capability.

name: anthranilate 1,2-dioxygenase, antAB system
description: Two-subunit oxygenase of the ant type. The shared ferredoxin and ferredoxin reductase components of this system are deliberately not curated: they are interchangeable between Rieske systems and are annotated two to three times less often than the substrate-determining subunits, so requiring them would turn an annotation gap into a missing capability.

name: anthranilate 1,2-dioxygenase, andAcAd system
description: Alternative two-subunit oxygenase annotated to a different orthology group. The shared ferredoxin and ferredoxin reductase components of this system are deliberately not curated: they are interchangeable between Rieske systems and are annotated two to three times less often than the substrate-determining subunits, so requiring them would turn an annotation gap into a missing capability.

name: multicomponent phenol 2-monooxygenase
description: Six jointly required subunits. Unlike the Rieske systems in this layer these components are the enzyme itself, not interchangeable electron carriers, so all six are required.

name: fused enol-lactonase/decarboxylase PcaL
description: Alternative single-protein system in which the hydrolase is fused to a 4-carboxymuconolactone decarboxylase.

name: 3-oxoadipate CoA-transferase
description: Two jointly required subunits of the heterotetrameric transferase.

name: catechol 2,3-dioxygenase
description: Single-protein catalytic system with two accepted markers in different namespaces.

name: 2-oxopent-4-enoate hydratase, bph/xyl type
description: Alternative single-protein system annotated to a separate orthology group.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxovalerate aldolase, bph/xyl type
description: Alternative single-protein system annotated to a separate orthology group.

name: acylating acetaldehyde dehydrogenase, mhp type
description: Alternative system for a reaction already curated for ethanol formation. MhpF is the standalone counterpart of the AdhE aldehyde domain and carries no alcohol dehydrogenase activity.

name: acylating acetaldehyde dehydrogenase, bph/xyl type
description: Alternative system annotated to a separate orthology group.

name: phenylacetate-CoA ligase
description: Single-protein catalytic system with two accepted markers in different namespaces.

name: ring-1,2-phenylacetyl-CoA epoxidase
description: Five jointly required subunits of the epoxidase complex.

name: oxepin-CoA hydrolase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; the same bifunctional PaaZ protein carries the next step.

name: 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberyl-CoA semialdehyde dehydrogenase
description: Single-protein catalytic system; the same bifunctional PaaZ protein carries the preceding step.

name: 2,3-didehydroadipoyl-CoA hydratase
description: Single-protein catalytic system using a chain-generic beta-oxidation orthologue.

name: 3-hydroxyadipyl-CoA dehydrogenase
description: Single-protein catalytic system using a chain-generic beta-oxidation orthologue.

name: 3-phenylpropanoate dioxygenase oxygenase component
description: Two-subunit Rieske oxygenase. The shared ferredoxin and ferredoxin reductase components of this system are deliberately not curated: they are interchangeable between Rieske systems and are annotated two to three times less often than the substrate-determining subunits, so requiring them would turn an annotation gap into a missing capability.

name: tryptophan synthase complex
description: Alpha and beta subunits are jointly required.

name: 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase complex
description: Large and small subunits are jointly required.

name: bifunctional imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase/histidinol-phosphatase
description: The Enterobacterial HisB carries both activities on one chain.

name: N-succinyldiaminopimelate aminotransferase
description: Single catalytic protein; alternative orthologs are OR.

name: prephenate dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein; TyrA is bifunctional with the mutase.

name: chorismate mutase
description: Single catalytic protein; the bifunctional P-protein and T-protein forms are alternatives.

name: histidinol-phosphate phosphatase
description: Single catalytic protein; three non-homologous phosphatase families are known.

name: bifunctional imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase/histidinol-phosphatase
description: The Enterobacterial HisB carries both activities on one chain.

name: acetylglutamate kinase
description: Single catalytic protein; several bifunctional forms exist.

name: delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate synthetase
description: Bifunctional kinase and dehydrogenase on one chain.

name: aromatic aminotransferase
description: Single catalytic protein; alternative orthologs are OR.

name: 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase complex
description: Large and small subunits are jointly required.

name: ATP phosphoribosyltransferase
description: Catalytic subunit. The HisZ regulatory subunit found in some Firmicutes is not required.

name: alanine-synthesising transaminase
description: Single catalytic protein; alternative orthologs are OR.

name: valine-pyruvate transaminase
description: Transaminase C, which forms alanine using L-valine as the amino donor.

name: delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate synthetase
description: Bifunctional kinase and dehydrogenase on one chain.

name: phosphoribosyl-AMP cyclohydrolase
description: Single catalytic protein; several bifunctional forms exist.

name: prephenate dehydratase
description: Single catalytic protein; PheA is bifunctional with the mutase.

name: anthranilate synthase complex
description: Component I and the glutamine amidotransferase component II are jointly required.

name: anthranilate synthase, fused
description: Single polypeptide carrying both anthranilate synthase functions.

name: aspartate aminotransferase
description: Single catalytic protein; alternative orthologs are OR.

name: 3-isopropylmalate/2-methylmalate dehydratase complex
description: Large and small subunits are jointly required.

name: phosphoribosyl-ATP pyrophosphohydrolase
description: Single catalytic protein; several bifunctional forms exist.

name: amino-acid N-acetyltransferase
description: Single catalytic protein; several bifunctional forms exist.

name: imidazole glycerol-phosphate synthase complex
description: The cyclase and the glutamine amidotransferase subunits are jointly required.

name: aromatic aminotransferase
description: Single catalytic protein; alternative orthologs are OR.

name: acetohydroxyacid synthase
description: Catalytic large subunit. The IlvN/IlvH small subunit is regulatory and is not required, on the precedent already recorded for the PyrI regulatory subunit of aspartate carbamoyltransferase.

name: histidinol dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein carrying out both oxidations.

name: histidinol dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein carrying out both oxidations.

name: 3-isopropylmalate/2-methylmalate dehydratase complex
description: Large and small subunits are jointly required.

name: glycine reductase complex
description: Selenoprotein A, the substrate-specific protein B subunits and both protein C subunits are jointly required.

name: D-proline reductase complex
description: PrdA and the selenocysteine-containing PrdB are jointly required. The PrdD and PrdE stabilising proteins are not required, on the precedent recorded for the PyrI regulatory subunit.

name: threonine ammonia-lyase
description: Single catalytic protein; the biosynthetic IlvA and the catabolic TdcB belong to the same orthology group.

name: L-cysteine desulfidase
description: Single catalytic protein. The promiscuous PLP enzymes that also carry this activity -- cystathionine beta-lyase, cystathionine gamma-lyase, MalY -- are deliberately excluded: accepting them would make every transsulfuration genome a sulfide producer, and MetC is already curated as evidence for cysteine biosynthesis.

name: malate synthase
description: Single direct malate-synthase protein; the two-step malyl-CoA implementation is not folded into this reaction.

name: molybdenum nitrogenase with cofactor assembly
description: NifHDK catalysis and electron delivery plus the NifEN scaffold and NifB precursor synthesis. Every component is required.

name: vanadium nitrogenase with cofactor assembly
description: VnfHDGK catalysis and electron delivery plus the VnfEN scaffold and shared NifB precursor synthesis. Every component is required.

name: heterodimeric CysDN sulfate adenylyltransferase
description: Both CysN and CysD are required.

name: CysD with bifunctional CysNC sulfate adenylyltransferase
description: CysNC supplies the CysN sulfurylase subunit and CysD supplies its required partner.

name: APS kinase domain of CysNC
description: The bifunctional fusion supplies the complete kinase activity.

name: PAPS reductase
description: Reaction-specific activity marker used because the CysH KO also spans APS reductase.

name: APS reductase
description: Reaction-specific activity marker used because the CysH KO also spans PAPS reductase.

name: NADPH sulfite reductase CysJI
description: Both the flavoprotein and siroheme subunits are required.

name: HemE uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase
description: Single catalytic protein shared by every curated heme-b route.

name: HemY protoporphyrinogen oxidase
description: Single catalytic protein; the same KO also supplies the copro-specific reaction in its own system.

name: HemJ protoporphyrinogen oxidase
description: Single catalytic protein; the electron acceptor remains abstract in Rhea.

name: HemH protoporphyrin ferrochelatase
description: Single catalytic protein; the same KO also supplies coproferrochelatase in its own system.

name: HemY coproporphyrinogen oxidase
description: Single catalytic protein using the copro-specific activity of HemY.

name: HemH coproporphyrin ferrochelatase
description: Single catalytic protein using the copro-specific activity of HemH.

name: EntB isochorismate lyase
description: Single bifunctional protein; this system uses its lyase domain.

name: Enterobactin synthetase machinery
description: EntB, EntD, EntE and EntF are jointly required for carrier activation, substrate loading, condensation and cyclisation.

name: GbsB choline dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein of the Gram-positive GbsAB architecture.

name: choline oxidase, first oxidation
description: Single catalytic protein; the same marker is required again for the second reaction.

name: choline oxidase, second oxidation
description: Single catalytic protein; the same marker supplies the first reaction too.

name: betaine-aldehyde dehydrogenase
description: Single catalytic protein accepted only on the substrate-specific KO.

name: multifunctional siroheme synthase CysG ferrochelatase
description: Single catalytic protein system; the same CysG marker also supplies the preceding methylation and dehydrogenation reactions.

name: bifunctional precorrin-2 dehydrogenase and sirohydrochlorin ferrochelatase Met8
description: Single catalytic protein system; the same Met8 marker also supplies the preceding dehydrogenation reaction.

name: endochitinase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: lytic polysaccharide monooxygenase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: sialidase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: alpha-L-fucosidase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: endo-polygalacturonase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: exo-polygalacturonase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.

name: pectinesterase
description: Single catalytic protein system; alternative markers are OR.
